content.value: Bismuth (melting point 520º F) and cadmiúm (melting point 610ºF) are assumed to be completely soluble in the liquid state and completely insoluble in the solid state. They form a eutectic at 290º F containing 40% cadmium.
i) Draw the equilibrium diagram to scale on a piece of graph paper labeling all points, lines and areas.
ii) For an alloy containing 70% cadmium; give the temperature of initial solidification and give the chemical composition and relative amounts of the phases present at a temperature of 100º F.
